record.prompt: Navigate to the shelf and report observations. If object is found and is a cup, inspect the cup and report the observations.
record.output: The robot starts at base and navigates to the shelf. It then reports observations of the cup on the shelf.
record.system_prompt: You are helping a mobile robot. It starts at base. It can navigate to base, shelf or desk, inspect a known object, report observations, or stop. There is a cup on the shelf and a book on the desk. The robot has a camera and wheels but no arm or gripper. It cannot pick up or carry objects. Suggest a short plan using only these capabilities. If information is missing, ask a specific clarification question. If the task is impossible for this robot, explain why. Use at most four short sentences.
record.model_input: Navigate to the shelf and report observations. If object is found and is a cup, inspect the cup and report the observations.
